title: ResearchTraceV1
description: Portable trace document for a ResearchWorkspaceBundleV1 run. Records the ordered sequence of execution events emitted by the chain so the run can be inspected and replayed. The contract is STRICT: unknown fields are rejected at the trace root and on every event. Adapter-specific provenance that must survive portability is carried in the explicit, versioned `extensions` object on the trace root and on each event, never as arbitrary top-level or event-envelope fields.

chain_id.description: Identifier of the NodeChain chain (blueprint) that produced the trace.

events.description: Ordered sequence of execution events. Order IS semantically meaningful (this is a chronological trace), so it is NOT subject to set-like canonicalization.

step_id.description: Monotonic step index within the run.

node_id.description: Node id of the step that emitted the event.

actor.description: Identity of the actor that emitted the event (node id, adapter name, or 'orchestrator').

extensions_version.description: Version of the per-event extension vocabulary. Required iff `extensions` is present on this event.

extensions.description: Explicit per-event extension surface for adapter-specific provenance. Use only when a field must travel with the portable trace; arbitrary event-envelope fields are rejected.

total_cost_usd.description: Aggregate cost of the run in USD, if known.

total_duration_ms.description: Aggregate wall-clock duration of the run in milliseconds, if known.

summary.description: Optional free-form summary statistics about the trace. Summary is explicitly free-form (it is non-authoritative descriptive metadata); authoritative structured data lives in versioned, named fields above.

extensions_version.description: Version of the trace-root extension vocabulary. Required iff `extensions` is present at the trace root.

extensions.description: Explicit trace-root extension surface. The only place arbitrary adapter-defined fields may appear on the trace root; unknown top-level fields outside this object are rejected.
